그는 우리에게 포기하지 말라고 부탁했다. (not / asked / he / us / to / give up)
questions.answer: He asked us not to give up.
questions.why: ask+목적어+not to-v 어순으로 배열한다.
alt: He asked us not to give up

questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 우리말에 맞게 문장을 완성하시오. (과거시제)
의사는 나에게 일찍 자라고 충고했다. (the doctor, advise, me, go to bed early)
questions.answer: The doctor advised me to go to bed early.
questions.why: advise+목적어+to부정사 어순, 과거시제 advised를 쓴다.
alt: The doctor advised me to go to bed early

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. The principal asked the students to keep the playground clean.
ㄴ. My parents want me to becoming a teacher.
ㄷ. She told her little brother not to open the oven door.
questions.why: ㄴ은 to 뒤에 동사원형 become이 와야 하므로 틀렸다. ㄱ, ㄷ은 to-v와 not to-v를 바르게 썼다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. He advised me to reading the book twice.
ㄴ. The guard told the visitors not to take photos inside.
ㄷ. I asked my teacher explain the problem again.
questions.why: ㄱ은 to read, ㄷ은 to explain이 되어야 한다. ㄴ은 not to-v를 바르게 썼다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· Mom wants me to walk the dog every morning.
· The teacher told us handing in the report by Friday.
· He asked her not to move his things.
· They allowed the children to swimming in the pool.
· The doctor advised him to eat less salt.
questions.why: 두 번째는 to hand in, 네 번째는 to swim이 되어야 하므로 옳은 문장은 3개이다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
· I want you to remember this moment.
· She asked me to turn down the music.
· Dad told me not to leaving the door open.
· Our school allows us to wear casual clothes on Fridays.
· He advised her to not worry about the test.
questions.why: not to leaving은 not to leave로, to not worry는 not to worry로 고쳐야 하므로 틀린 문장은 2개이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 바꿔 쓴 것으로 알맞은 것은?
The teacher said to us, "Don't bring food into the computer room."
choices: The teacher told us don't bring food into the computer room.
The teacher told us not bring food into the computer room.
The teacher told us not to bring food into the computer room.
The teacher told us to not bring food into the computer room.
The teacher told us not bringing food into the computer room.
questions.why: 부정 명령문은 tell+목적어+not to-v로 바꾸므로 ③이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Mom said to me, "Please water the plants while I'm away."
→ Mom asked me ____ the plants while she was away.
questions.why: 「Please+명령문」은 ask+목적어+to부정사로 바꾸므로 to water가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Last week, my mom ① <u>asked</u> me to take care of my little sister. She told me ② <u>to give</u> her lunch and ③ <u>played</u> with her. She also told me ④ <u>not to give</u> her too much candy. I wanted her ⑤ <u>to have</u> a good time.
questions.why: told me to give ... and (to) play와 병렬을 이루어야 하므로 played가 아니라 (to) play가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Our coach wants us ① <u>to practice</u> hard every day. Yesterday he told us ② <u>to run</u> ten laps and asked us ③ <u>to stretch</u> after running. He also advised us ④ <u>drinking</u> enough water. Finally, he told us ⑤ <u>not to skip</u> meals.
questions.why: advise의 목적격 보어는 to부정사이므로 drinking이 아니라 to drink가 맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
· The teacher told us (A) ____ the safety rules. (follow)
· She asked me (B) ____ the window because it was cold. (open, 부정)
· My parents want me (C) ____ an honest person. (be)
choices: to follow – not to open – to be
to follow – to not open – to be
following – not to open – to be
questions.why: 세 동사 모두 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 쓰고, 부정은 not to-v이므로 ①이 맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
· He advised her (A) ____ a doctor right away. (see)
· Mom allowed me (B) ____ my friends to dinner. (invite)
· I told him (C) ____ late again. (be, 부정)
choices: to see – to invite – to not be
to see – inviting – not to be
to see – to invite – not to be
seeing – to invite – not to be
questions.why: advise/allow/tell 모두 to부정사 보어를 취하고, 부정은 not to be이므로 ④가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
The doctor said to him, "Don't drink too much coffee."
= The doctor advised him ____ too much coffee.
questions.why: 부정의 충고는 advise+목적어+not to-v로 나타내므로 not to drink가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
부모님은 내가 시험 전에 휴대폰을 사용하지 않기를 원하신다.
choices: My parents want me not to use my phone before the exam.
My parents want me to not use my phone before the exam.
My parents want me don't use my phone before the exam.
My parents want not me to use my phone before the exam.
My parents want me not using my phone before the exam.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 to 바로 앞에 not을 붙인 not to-v 어순이다. want+목적어+not to-v 어순인 ①이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 짝지어진 것은?
(a) I asked the waiter to bring the menu.
(b) She wants her son become a pilot.
(c) The teacher allowed us to leave early.
(d) He told me to not touch the wire.
questions.why: (b)는 to become, (d)는 not to touch가 되어야 한다. (a), (c)만 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ㄱ. The doctor advised my grandfather to walk slowly on icy roads.
ㄴ. I want everyone in my class to enjoy the field trip.
ㄷ. She asked me not to sitting on her bed.
ㄹ. Our teacher doesn't allow us to eat snacks in class.
questions.why: ㄷ은 not to sit이 되어야 하므로 옳은 문장은 ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ 3개이다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
She ____ me to check the schedule again.
questions.why: say는 「목적어+to부정사」 형태로 쓸 수 없다. 나머지 동사는 모두 가능하다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
The teacher asked me <u>to read</u> my essay aloud.
choices: I have a lot of homework <u>to do</u> tonight.
She was happy <u>to see</u> her old friend.
My dream is <u>to open</u> a small bakery.
Mom wants me <u>to clean</u> the bathroom.
He went to the store <u>to buy</u> some milk.
questions.why: 주어진 문장의 to read는 목적격 보어이다. ④의 to clean도 want의 목적격 보어이다. ①은 형용사적, ②⑤는 부사적, ③은 명사적 용법이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 바르게 고친 것은?
The guide told the tourists to not leave the group.
choices: to not leave → not to leave
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 to 바로 앞에 not을 붙인 not to-v 어순이다. 따라서 not to leave로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
A: Did your mom (A) ____ you to come straight home?
B: Yes. She also told me (B) ____ anywhere on the way.
questions.why: 조동사 did 뒤에는 동사원형 tell을 쓰고, 부정 보어는 not to stop으로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Jisu was worried about her grades, so she talked to her teacher. The teacher advised her ____ a study plan and follow it every day.
questions.why: advise의 목적격 보어는 to부정사이므로 to make가 맞고, 뒤의 follow는 to가 생략된 병렬 구조이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 나머지 넷과 문장 구조가 다른 것은?
choices: I want to drink something cold.
I want you to drink enough water.
She told him to slow down.
They asked us to vote for them.
He advised me to take notes in class.
questions.why: ①은 to부정사가 목적어인 3형식이고, 나머지는 「동사+목적어+to부정사(목적격 보어)」의 5형식이다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. My uncle allowed me to feed the horses on the farm.
ㄴ. The teacher wants us to not use slang in essays.
ㄷ. She asked her neighbor to turning down the TV.
questions.why: ㄴ은 not to use, ㄷ은 to turn down이 되어야 한다. ㄱ만 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 「동사+목적어+to부정사」 문장으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
"Study for the test," Mom said to me.
choices: Mom told me study for the test.
Mom told me to study for the test.
Mom told to me to study for the test.
Mom told me studying for the test.
Mom told that I study for the test.
questions.why: 명령문은 tell+목적어+to부정사로 바꾸므로 ②가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 조건을 모두 만족하는 문장은?
[조건] · advise의 과거형을 쓸 것 · 부정의 to부정사를 쓸 것
choices: The doctor advised me to stay up late.
The doctor advises me not to stay up late.
The doctor advised me not to stay up late.
The doctor advised me to not stay up late.
The doctor advised me don't stay up late.
questions.why: 과거형 advised와 올바른 부정 어순 not to stay를 모두 갖춘 것은 ③뿐이다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Because the roads were icy, the police asked drivers ____ slowly and carefully.
questions.why: ask의 목적격 보어는 to부정사이므로 to drive가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾아 바르게 고친 것은?
My parents don't allow me staying out late on weekdays.
questions.why: allow의 목적격 보어는 to부정사이므로 staying을 to stay로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The teacher told us to bring our textbooks and ____ the first chapter before class.
questions.why: to bring과 병렬 구조이며, 병렬된 두 번째 to부정사는 to를 생략하고 동사원형 read로 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: You look tired. What did the doctor say?
B: He advised me ____ at least eight hours every night, but I can't.
questions.why: advise의 목적격 보어는 to부정사이므로 to sleep이 맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳게 쓰인 문장은?
choices: Ms. Choi asked the students to hand in their reports by noon.
Ms. Choi asked the students handing in their reports by noon.
Ms. Choi asked the students hand in their reports by noon.
Ms. Choi asked that the students to hand in their reports by noon.
Ms. Choi asked to the students to hand in their reports by noon.
questions.why: ask+목적어+to부정사 어순인 ①이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
· He told me <u>not to be</u> afraid of making mistakes.
· She wants us <u>to not forget</u> the meeting time.
· Mom asked me <u>not to leave</u> the door open.
· The coach advised us <u>not skipping</u> practice.
· They allowed her <u>not to answer</u> the question.
questions.why: to not forget과 not skipping은 not to-v 어순이 아니므로 틀렸다. 옳은 것은 3개이다.

questions.stem:
(A), (B)에서 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
Before the field trip, our teacher told us (A) [to wear / wearing] comfortable shoes and asked us (B) [not to bring / to bring not] too much money.
questions.why: tell/ask 모두 to부정사 보어를 취하고 부정은 not to-v이므로 to wear – not to bring이 맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 「동사+목적어+to부정사」 구조가 쓰이지 않은 문장은?
choices: I want him to win the race.
She told me to bring my own cup.
He promised to call me tonight.
They asked her to move her car.
The doctor advised us to wash our hands often.
questions.why: ③은 promise+to부정사(목적어)의 3형식이고, 나머지는 목적어 뒤에 to부정사 보어가 온 5형식이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 안내원은 방문객들에게 박물관에서 사진을 찍지 말라고 말했다.
choices: The guide told the visitors not to take pictures in the museum.
The guide told the visitors to not take pictures in the museum.
The guide told the visitors don't take pictures in the museum.
The guide told not the visitors to take pictures in the museum.
The guide said the visitors not to take pictures in the museum.
questions.why: tell+목적어+not to-v 어순인 ①이 맞다. say는 이 구조로 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
· The firefighters told everyone ____ calm.
· My mom wants me ____ more careful with my things.
questions.why: tell과 want 모두 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 쓰므로 to be가 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem:
다음 글에서 어법상 틀린 문장은?
① My sister wanted me to teach her English. ② So I told her to memorize ten words every day. ③ I also advised her to watching English cartoons. ④ I asked her not to give up easily. ⑤ Now she can introduce herself in English.
questions.why: to 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 to watching이 아니라 to watch가 맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 우리말과 영어가 바르게 짝지어지지 않은 것은?
choices: 나는 그가 오기를 원한다. – I want him to come.
그는 나에게 앉으라고 말했다. – He told me to sit down.
그녀는 내게 늦지 말라고 부탁했다. – She asked me to be late.
엄마는 내가 나가는 것을 허락했다. – Mom allowed me to go out.
의사는 그에게 쉬라고 충고했다. – The doctor advised him to rest.
questions.why: '늦지 말라고'이므로 asked me not to be late가 되어야 한다. not이 빠져 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. The captain told the sailors to check the weather.
ㄴ. I don't want you to worry about me.
ㄷ. She allowed the kids to played outside.
ㄹ. He asked me to explain the rules again.
questions.why: ㄷ은 to play가 되어야 하므로 틀렸다. 나머지 ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ은 모두 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
I said to my brother, "Don't ride my bike."
choices: I told my brother not to ride my bike.
I told my brother to ride my bike.
I asked my brother to ride my bike.
I told my brother that ride my bike.
I wanted my brother riding my bike.
questions.why: 부정 명령문의 전달은 tell+목적어+not to-v로 나타내므로 ①이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
Mr. Han ____ his students not to be late for the rehearsal.
questions.why: let은 목적격 보어로 동사원형을 쓰므로 not to be 앞에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem:
다음 단어들을 모두 한 번씩 사용하여 문장을 만들 때, 다섯 번째에 오는 단어는?
(the / teacher / told / us / not / to / give / up)
questions.why: The teacher told us not to give up. 어순이므로 다섯 번째 단어는 not이다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
A: Mom, can I go to Jina's house?
B: Yes, but I want you (A) ____ home by seven. Don't forget!
A: Okay. Anything else?
B: Yes, I'm asking you (B) ____ your homework there, too.
questions.why: want와 ask 모두 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 쓰므로 to be – to do가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법과 문맥상 알맞은 것은?
The museum staff asked the children ____ the old paintings, so they just looked at them.
questions.why: 뒤에서 '그냥 보기만 했다'고 했으므로 만지지 말라는 not to touch가 맞다. to not touch는 틀린 어순이다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
· He wanted the singer to sign his album.
· The teacher told to us to review chapter three.
· I asked Dad to fix my bike chain.
· Mom advised me to not eat before swimming.
· She allows her dog to sit on the sofa.
questions.why: told to us는 told us로, to not eat은 not to eat으로 고쳐야 하므로 틀린 문장은 2개이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 조건에 맞게 영작한 것으로 옳은 것은?
나는 네가 그 시험을 포기하지 않기를 원한다.
[조건] want와 부정의 to부정사를 사용할 것
choices: I want you not to give up the test.
I don't want you to give up the test.
I want you to give not up the test.
I want you to not give up the test.
I want not you to give up the test.
questions.why: 부정의 to부정사(not to-v)를 쓴 것은 ①뿐이다. ②는 문장 부정이라 조건에 맞지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Yesterday my grandmother visited us. She asked me ① <u>to show</u> her how to send photos on her phone. I told her ② <u>to tap</u> the camera icon first. She wanted me ③ <u>to write</u> the steps down, so I did. I also advised her ④ <u>not to press</u> the red button. She told me ⑤ <u>calling</u> her if she had questions.
questions.why: tell의 목적격 보어는 to부정사이므로 calling이 아니라 to call이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
The teacher said to me, "You should read more books."
= The teacher advised me ____ more books.
questions.why: 충고의 내용은 advise+목적어+to부정사로 나타내므로 to read가 맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 올바르게 쓰인 문장은?
choices: The dentist advised me not to eating candy at night.
The dentist advised me not to eat candy at night.
The dentist advised me to don't eat candy at night.
The dentist advised me not eat candy at night.
The dentist advised me no to eat candy at night.
questions.why: to부정사의 부정은 to 바로 앞에 not을 붙인 not to-v 어순이다. not to eat으로 쓴 ②만 맞다.

questions.stem:
